name: Quietus — 3 Advanced — Condemn the Sins of the Father

system.description: An extremely rare, Methuselah-level Quietus technique reputedly used at the core of ur-Shulgi's ritual to enact the Breaking. It allows a Cainite to apply a lesser Quietus power to an entire lineage of descendants at once. After successfully using any lesser Quietus power on another vampire, spend a permanent Willpower Trait and eight Blood Traits, then enter a Physical Challenge (retest Occult) against the original target, whose Trait total for this challenge equals his own Physical Traits plus twice the number of generations of descendants you wish to affect. If you win, every descendant within the specified generation range suffers the same effects the original target experienced, each resisting individually with his own appropriate Traits. You may exempt a number of potential targets equal to your Mental Traits, but you must know their faces or have tasted their vitae.
system.bloodCost: 8 Blood Traits and 1 permanent Willpower Trait
system.prerequisites: Any lesser Quietus power (must be used successfully first); Methuselah-tier power
